ValidationRule.description: A signed acknowledgment is legal evidence. Once written it is never edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(TermsVersion__c), ISCHANGED(SignatureText__c), ISCHANGED(AcknowledgedDate__c), ISCHANGED(LoginHistoryId__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A signed terms acknowledgment cannot be changed.
